[A10] Ready. Executor [A327]; reviewers [R330] internal and [R331] external. Branch `509-pp-descriptor-ownership` from dev `7eb3b0d4`. #400/#403 has merged, so the shared builder files are free.

**Decision on the open question** (which checks the processor keeps and which the parent owns):
- **The processor keeps** the generic packed-image checks that hold for any valid model: structural L1-L10 invariants such as offsets and lengths inside the image, descriptor type/index consistency and table well-formedness.
- **The parent owns** the shipping-model semantics that depend on a configuration: identity and model-ID evolution, AUDIO_UNIT offsets/counts/lengths per configuration, ADP stream-count maxima across configurations, and the clock-source-list shape. The builder enforces each of these with a discriminating negative check.
- Where both repositories check the same rule, the matrix says which check is authoritative and which is defence in depth.

Scope (acceptance 1-4 as written):
1. The matrix goes in the parent as a reference page. Every row cites a check path, and a structural construction is distinguished from a discriminating refusal.
2. The evidence covers all five tracked configurations: decoded offsets, counts, lengths, source-list shape and advertised metadata. Include a legal boundary and one invalid change for every claimed refusal.
3. The identity reconciliation with descriptor bytes, and the parent contract text updated. The processor contract text (`07_memory_maps.md`) changes in a separate processor PR after this one is reviewed. List the exact wording it needs in HANDOFF.
4. Every newly found product defect gets a bounded follow-up with evidence, filed by me from your list. Do not fix it in this lane.

Validation plan: full builder test with the pinned SDK and without
a compiler; generator self-test with its #464 state recorded;
NVM, bare-metal, documentation, CI, style, source-list, lint,
traceability and behavior gates specified in the assignment.

Roles: author [A327]; independent reviewers [R330] and [R331].
The public readiness decision is recorded; board moved to In progress.
Blockers: none. Publication and merge remain with the maintainer.

[A327] REVIEW READY

Commit: `20423082f221a02f3de72952cec4e1ac0c839b1d`
Branch: `509-pp-descriptor-ownership`; base `7eb3b0d4a6987fd2e93ffc3b5be125267df7f53a`.

Changed: published the parent L1-L10/ADP allocation in
`docs/reference/PP_DESCRIPTOR_OWNERSHIP.md`, added reproducible packed-byte
measurements in `scripts/audit_pp_descriptors.py`, and reconciled the builder
reference's census and identity claims. Four files; no production validator,
shipping input, RTL, donor or pin change. Local commit only.

Acceptance evidence:
- Matrix rows name clauses, producers/consumers, check paths, configuration bounds and open owners; construction and discriminating refusals are separate.
- All five images decoded: 32/64/96/41/116 descriptors and 5792/10112/15360/7352/18288 bytes in reference-page order. All 15 generator CLI invocations passed and matched the audited image hashes. The receipt contains 30 packer, 13 YAML and two map probes.
- The generator-only reset_time mutation changes arty_4x4 image byte 6741 while model ID stays `0x001BC557FC6ABBC8`, retaining #495/processor #38 ownership. Parent contract updated; exact processor wording is in HANDOFF.md for its separate reviewed change. No implementation relies on that unpublished update.
- Follow-ups F1-F6 are bounded for maintainer filing: invalid model IDs, listener buffer floor, format validation, INTERNAL source availability, the F07.2 zero-cluster discrepancy, and parent L6/L10 image checks. The discrepancy needs a public clause-backed disposition under processor #60. #478/#464 stay closed and unexpanded; runtime processor #82 work stays excluded.

Validation: all requested commands returned 0; 29 recorded modes including the
audit and entity-shape self-test. Both complete builder runs passed using an
invocation wrapper: verified SDK mapping with `--require-rv32`, then deliberate
absence of all three cross-compiler candidates. SDK mode excludes only gate 11
calibration (missing placement report); absent mode additionally excludes the
compiler-backed gate 1b instruments. These exclusions are not counted as passes.

The #464-repaired generator self-test passes 20 checks and retains six declared
compatibility-map deviations. Entity-shape: 136 checks, zero failures. Behavior:
344 scenarios and 1739 steps pass. Both CI documentation modes pass; filesystem
mode has the expected inventory-parity skip. Existing xvlog/RTL lint ratchets
remain at 4/90 findings. Worktree clean after the final run.

No multi-configuration maximum proof or product-compliance verdict is claimed.
The output handoff contains file:line changes, image/evidence/gate tables,
compiler invocation receipts, exact separate processor wording and PR-BODY.md.
Independent reviews remain with [R330] and [R331]; publication remains with the maintainer.

[A10] Round 2 for PR #568 at `20423082`, executor [A333].
- [R331] R331-1 is POSITIVE: https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/pull/568#issuecomment-5845356060
- [R330] R330-1 is NEGATIVE on three MINORs: https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/pull/568#issuecomment-5845348382

1. **R330-1 M1.** The identity probe in `scripts/audit_pp_descriptors.py` re-derives the model identity with the generator change applied, so it can observe the fix it is evidence for. Add a control that fails when the identity derivation ignores the changed field.
2. **R330-1 M2.** Add a bounded follow-up record (F7) for the newly measured processor-owned gap: body type/index against the directory key.
3. **R330-1 M3.** The six static-map deviations in the shipping `arty_current` image get a live owner: link the open issue, or add a bounded follow-up record. Correct the L7 row.
4. **R331-1 S1.** Replace the audit's integrity `assert` statements with explicit refusals, so that `python3 -O` cannot strip them.
5. **R331-1 S2.** The L6 row names the processor's sub-rules, for example at least one CLOCK_SOURCE per CLOCK_DOMAIN.

The other suggestions go to #495. After this round, [R330] reviews the delta, and R331-1 stands as the ancestor POSITIVE.

[A333] REVIEW READY

Local commit: `04c9802d852befba3b5d854ba5f3faf3ddfc59a7` (not pushed, per assignment).

Changed: round-2 items 1-5 are implemented. The identity probe reloads with the generator change active and runs a discriminating control; audit integrity refusals survive optimization; F7 owns body/directory consistency; F8 owns the six shipping static-map deviations; L6 and L7 now state the measured boundaries.

Validation: all 30 recorded local gate invocations returned 0, including the complete builder in verified SDK and compiler-absent modes, NVM/bare-metal checks, both documentation CI modes, all assigned lint/style/contract gates, behave (344 scenarios), generator self-test and entity-shape self-test (136 checks). Existing exclusions remain explicit: SDK calibration; absent-mode compiler instruments and calibration; no-Git inventory parity.

The audit and both reviewers' probes/mutants were rerun against this head. Pristine receipt SHA-256 remains `8233f515e8e469570314fdfea9437db5d082a6441f04a75ff840efe5444f4779`. R330 M3 now changes identity exactly as the fresh-process CLI does. R331 M3 refuses in normal and optimized Python. Other mutants retain their expected outcomes. Published probe bodies were unchanged; R331's old-head checkout wrapper was replaced by disposable candidate exports to respect the assignment.

Acceptance: all five round-2 items met with recorded evidence. `509-a333/HANDOFF.md` contains file:line changes, every probe/mutant verdict and exact gate commands/results; `PR-BODY.md` contains the complete updated PR body. Temporary evidence, exports and interpreter were removed. Worktree clean; pins unchanged.

Open work: R330 delta re-review, maintainer publication and F7/F8 filing. R331-1 remains the ancestor external positive per the assignment. No push, PR edit or merge performed.

[A10] Follow-ups filed from the reviewed matrix: F1 #573, F2 #574, F3 #575, F4 #576, F6 #577, F8 #578 (parent); F5 Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan#122 and F7 Mister-M-alt/protocol-processor-control-plane-avb-milan#123 (processor).
